issues.title: Vault divergence: Documents vault vs workspace vault
issues.detail: ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault contains older versions of AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, SOUL.md, etc. These may be stale/conflicting with workspace vault versions. No sync mechanism visible.
issues.recommendation: Archive Documents vault. Do not edit. Treat workspace vault as canonical.

issues.title: No MOC (Map of Content) index files
issues.detail: 117 root-level items with no visible MOC structure. Navigation relies on memory/search rather than linked hierarchy.
issues.recommendation: Create HOME.md, EMPIRE_INDEX.md, TRADING_INDEX.md, BLCO_INDEX.md, INFRASTRUCTURE_INDEX.md as entry points.

issues.title: Only 2 community plugins (dataview + templater)
issues.detail: Dataview and Templater are installed but full community plugin ecosystem is minimal. Missing: graph-analysis, tasks, calendar, kanban, excalidraw.
issues.recommendation: Add Obsidian Tasks, Kanban, and Calendar plugins for project/task tracking visual layer.

issues.title: No Dataview queries deployed
issues.detail: Dataview is installed but no evidence of active DQL queries creating dynamic dashboards from YAML frontmatter.
issues.recommendation: Add frontmatter to key docs (status, tags, priority) and create Dataview dashboard notes.

issues.title: PDF reference vault (OC 1) not linked to workspace
issues.detail: 15+ PDF guides in ~/Downloads/OC 1 are not indexed or linked from the workspace vault.
issues.recommendation: Create REFERENCE_LIBRARY.md with links and summaries of each PDF guide.

issues.title: Node_modules and build artifacts pollute vault
issues.detail: Workspace vault includes antfarm/, mission-control/, codebase-memory-mcp/ which contain node_modules. Obsidian may index these.

issues.title: Daily notes in memory/ not linked to graph
issues.detail: 91 daily notes in memory/ exist but without linking strategy they form an isolated cluster in the graph.
issues.recommendation: Add daily note template with links to active projects and weekly review notes.

recommendations: Create .obsidianignore to exclude node_modules, dist/, *.jsonl secrets

Archive ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault — treat workspace vault as canonical

Deploy 3-5 Dataview dashboard queries for live project/agent status
Install Obsidian Tasks plugin for visual task tracking
Create REFERENCE_LIBRARY.md linking all PDFs from OC 1 vault
Set workspace .obsidian/templates.json to use templates/ directory
Create weekly note template that links daily notes together
Add graph colors/groups for categories: agents, projects, governance, trading
